    Tuesday 13 October 2026

    Morning briefing

    Morning briefing

    The share column ships flat at the room's median - 10 names, 2 of them short, their order an unshipped shadow (R81) - and the option column ships the room's own G_OPTION median on 10 legs (R79; the owner's ten a day - 0 DESK-FILLED, 2 R4-OVERFLOW (owner, 2026-10-06) at half stake), led by ACN 2026-10-16 $205C at 55.0; watchdog sits suspended on a congressional feed that still serves no record count, and the board sat after the open

    Executive summary

    Mandate: Mix (any). EXPOSURE share +0.239 [n=10] / option +0.178 [n=10] (SEAT-COMPUTED: Spearman on average ranks of the gate's shipped vector against candidates[].pct_change_1d signed +1 long / -1 short); both sit under 0.50, so no TAPE-CALL is owed on exposure. OVERNIGHT: Asia's bars are stale - Nikkei 225 -0.02% (last bar 2026-10-09), Hang Seng +0.25%, Shanghai Composite -0.43% and KOSPI -3.65% (last bars 2026-10-12) - so Asia disagreed with itself; Europe closed lower (FTSE 100 -0.06%, DAX -0.07%, Euro Stoxx 50 -0.55%) and the US futures implied a soft open (S&P 500 futures -0.19%, Nasdaq 100 futures -0.52%), with the US 10-year yield at 5.22 and the dollar index 102.23 (-0.34%). Expected shape: a straight session - the soft open the futures implied is neither reversed nor reclaimed, and the index closes the window near its freeze marks (SPY 777.07, QQQ 742.89 at the freeze, as_of 2026-10-13T16:21:08+00:00); only the Hang Seng's +0.25% disagreed with the futures while KOSPI and Shanghai agreed, too thin a split to call the retrace-and-reclaim shape, which this morning already printed on single names such as META (gap_read TRADED THROUGH, 336% of the window retraced). REGIME: mixed - SPY flat (-0.13% today, -0.26% 5d), QQQ (-2.21% 5d) and IWM (-1.82% 5d) trending down, ^VIX 15.44 and rising (+1.51%); the slate's chip names sit in a served 'chip sell-off deepens' tape (MU -9.83%, SNDK -12.32%, LITE -14.08%, AMAT -13.01% on the week) while the cycle composite projects +2.59% over the next 10 trading days, the lean the Timekeeper's column carries. DESK BRIEF: no figure in it disagrees with my prompt; its selection-factor figures are not served in my prompt, so I do not quote them. CONVICTION: thin and concentrated in two names - ACN (56.0 in the share and the contract median; its in-the-money $205C needs break_even_move_pct 1.0) and GOOGL (56.0 share, its contract held by an open claim); below them every column median sits between 54.0 and 48.0, a band too narrow to call conviction. Calibration does not rescue it: the best grade_return_corr in the room is the Timekeeper's 0.032 and four FILED seats run below -0.1 (Sam -0.185, Foreign Desk -0.136, Dagger -0.125, Glazier -0.119), so every line is filed at the served median and no departure is authored (R78, R86).

    ONE BET, SAID PLAINLY: nine of ten option legs are long calls (ACN, AMZN, META, CRM, NOW, WMT, CIEN, MSFT, LITE) - one bet on a large-cap rebound into the 2026-10-16 monthly expiry, best expression ACN at 56.0 on top; the column's only put is HWM at 50.0. In shares, C, GS and JPM are one bank-block bet on the Herald's shared 2026-10-16 event (C 51.5 over GS and JPM at 50.0), UNH and HUM one managed-care bet (HUM 51.0 over UNH 50.0), and NVDA and ANET one semis bet (NVDA 50.0 over ANET 48.0). PYRAMID: the leader is The Black Swan (equity 106791.51); its read carries no extra weight (R33). It diverges from the room on the puts - the PLTR contract at 76 against the room's 44.0, HWM 72 against 50.0, CAT 70 against 48.0 - and on WDC (71 against 48.0), while filing the banks' shares low (GS share view 36, C 38). MODEL: the net disagrees sharply with the room on C (-9.9926 against a share median of 51.5, a shipped share line), on two shipped legs, CIEN (-7.2136) and WMT (-6.0153), and on MS (+6.2831 against the room's contract median 26.0) and LRCX (+7.5713); I note it and move no grade. HOUSE RULES (decided before the freeze, never mid-session; the BOOK SHAPE= line above is read from columns.json as filed): (1) STAKES - ten share lines flat at 1.0 (R81); option legs at 1.0, the desk writing the owner's half stake on CIEN and LITE (R4-OVERFLOW, R129); I file no override and no stake moves after the freeze. (2) EXITS - each leg exits on its own R66 token: ratchet at its break-even, kill only on a CLOSE through its underlying level, else close on the last session before expiry (2026-10-15 for the 2026-10-16 legs, 2026-10-22 for the 2026-10-23 legs); a share line dies only on a close through its kill line, and no intraday print fires anything. (3) WINDFALL - a leg whose premium closes at 2 x its freeze premium banks half at the first mark the desk serves for that contract (R123); no share ticket goes on a name whose claimed contract sits in the money with no WINDFALL status served, which is why AAPL (REQMOVE -1.232) is vacated, while GOOGL, whose claimed contract is out of the money (REQMOVE 1.237), ships as shares only and never as a second contract. Desk, R92/R12 - the memo's listings against the persisted book: share: PASS; option: DIFF PRINTED (R92) - ACN memo 56.0 / shipped 55.0, AMZN memo 54.0 / shipped 53.9, META memo 53.0 / shipped 53.3, CRM memo 52.0 / shipped 52.7, NOW memo 51.5 / shipped 52.4, WMT memo 51.0 / shipped 52.1, CIEN memo 50.0 / shipped 51.6, HWM memo 50.0 / shipped 51.6, MSFT memo 50.0 / shipped 51.6, LITE memo 49.0 / shipped 51.0
